selected.restrictions_note: Raw VWorld response is not persisted; derived coordinate summary only.

notes: Juso normalized the address before VWorld geocoding.
VWorld geocoder returned a coordinate summary.
Parcel/PNU/building geometry still require official API verification.
VWorld WFS returned 17 parcel, 294 building, and 39 road features near the selected coordinate.
Nearby WFS building footprints are eligible for surrounding context massing.
Surrounding context candidates are selected by distance from the official local anchor within 130 m, then filtered for duplicate/same-PNU/oversized footprints.
Local 3D origin is anchored to official_parcel_centroid; satellite imagery is only draped as a visual texture over that WFS/cadastral frame.
WFS/cadastral geometry is the alignment authority; WMTS satellite imagery is a preview texture, not the legal geometry source.
Surrounding context massing uses VWorld WFS footprints only; procedural fill is suppressed.

layers.name: satellite_ground
layers.usage: visual texture draped onto cadastral/WFS local meter frame
layers.license_note: VWorld/ArcGIS/custom tiles are optional browser preview sources. This MVP requests live tiles only and does not cache or persist them.

layers.name: spatial_reference
layers.usage: local origin and geometry alignment authority
layers.license_note: Cadastral/WFS geometry determines preview alignment; imagery is not used to infer legal boundaries.

limitations: Exact PNU/parcel boundary not legally certified by this MVP
